title: How to Cancel Crunchyroll — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Crunchyroll Premium subscription. Switch to free tier with ads. Stop monthly charges in 2 minutes.
intro: Crunchyroll has a free ad-supported tier, so canceling just means downgrading. You keep access to a limited library with ads — just not the full premium catalog or offline downloads.

steps.title: Go to Crunchyroll account settings
steps.text: Visit crunchyroll.com/account/subscription while signed in. Or: click your profile → Settings → Subscription.

steps.title: Click "Cancel Subscription"
steps.text: Find the cancellation option in your subscription settings and click it.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Confirm your choice. Premium features remain until the end of your billing period, then you switch to the free tier.
steps.tip: The free tier gives you access to a limited anime library with ads. New episodes may have a 1-week delay compared to Premium.

warnings: If subscribed via Apple, Google, Roku, or Amazon, cancel through their platforms.
Offline downloads become unavailable after Premium expires.
Free tier has ads and a smaller content library, with delayed new episodes.
Your watchlist, history, and queue are preserved on the free tier.

faqs.q: Can I still watch anime free on Crunchyroll?
faqs.a: Yes. The free tier includes a limited anime library with ads. Most popular shows are available, but new episodes may have a 1-week delay vs. Premium.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Crunchyroll?
faqs.a: Crunchyroll may offer refunds within a few days of charge. Contact support through their help center. Apple/Google subscriptions go through their refund processes.

faqs.q: What's a free alternative to Crunchyroll?
faqs.a: Crunchyroll's own free tier (ad-supported), YouTube (some anime channels), and Tubi (limited anime library, free with ads) are options.

refund.details: Contact Crunchyroll support for refund requests. They may offer refunds for recent charges. Apple/Google subscriptions go through those platforms.

retentionTactics: Crunchyroll may offer a discounted rate or remind you of currently airing shows in your watchlist.
